verdict.rationale: Terraform's apply docs list a `-destroy` mode that "creates a plan to destroy all remote objects" (docs-45). Like any apply, that plan is previewed, approved, and executed in dependency order (docs-25, docs-44), which covers the core of a clean full-environment teardown. One user reports that a single-run Kubernetes/Helm setup "doesn't handle cluster deletion well" (comm-7), an edge-case limitation rather than a contradiction of the documented capability. missing for 10: dedicated in-depth documentation of the destroy workflow (e.g. a `terraform destroy` command page, dependency-ordered deletion details), independent hands-on corroboration of clean teardowns, and clarity on teardown reliability in multi-provider stacks like Kubernetes.
